audit_note: periodic binding audits are capped at 99 by the orchestrator; with a 95 s interval they cover the whole of a 900-window run (pre and post audits bracket every run)
basis: Stabilization requirement 3 (supervisor direction plan, point 4): fresh, independently initiated whole ten-device BENIGN runs on the isolated ENGINEERING broker (azta-eng), same corrected benign chain, same profiles and same observation pipeline as CAL2 (g6c-e01). Each run is one independent calibration session with its own run id, its own deterministic seeds and its own orchestrator start. Role CAL5 = benign calibration only. See docs/stabilization/CAL5_PROTOCOL.md.

N1.description: moderate delivery variation: Gaussian displacement SD 1 ms and rare stalls (0.2 percent, 20 to 70 ms); unchanged Gate 6C condition

N2.description: rough delivery variation: displacement SD 3 ms and stalls of 20 to 120 ms at 0.5 percent of the messages; unchanged Gate 6C condition

Q.description: quiet: the corrected publisher with no added variation

campaign: AZTA stabilization campaign (AZTA-EXP-v1), requirement 3: weak-device calibration
declared_in_commit: the commit that adds this file together with docs/stabilization/CAL5_PROTOCOL.md; the collect.log of the CAL5 collection records the start of every run after that commit
excluded_window_indices_rule: window 0 (lead-in) and every post-roll window (index greater than 900) are excluded from every role

roles_of_new_runs.g6c-s01: CAL5: benign calibration session 1 of 4; used only for the AZTA-EXP-v1 calibration constants and their stability analysis; never for detection evaluation, selection or formal experiments

use_rules: CAL5 (g6c-s01..s04) gives benign reconstruction-loss statistics of the EXISTING deployed models only; no model is fitted, selected or tuned on it
no detection rate, false-positive rate or trust-accuracy figure is computed on CAL5 and reported as evaluation evidence; only benign calibration stability (protocol section 4)
the reserved TEST runs and the consumed calibration runs are never opened
a run that is not CONSISTENT is renamed -VOID-<reason>, kept, listed and replaced by a substitute of the same role declared in a dated amendment, never deleted
